service: US OSHA Workplace Safety & Violation Compliance Auditor
description: Audits U.S. industrial, construction, and logistics establishments against OSHA enforcement inspections, citations (Willful, Repeat, Serious), financial penalties in USD, NAICS codes, and computes a Workplace Safety Risk Score (0-100).

inputSchema.title: US OSHA Workplace Safety & Violation Compliance Auditor Input
inputSchema.description: Configure company/establishment keyword, optional 2-letter U.S. state filter, and maximum OSHA enforcement inspection records to audit.

companyOrEstablishment.title: Company or Establishment Name
companyOrEstablishment.description: Employer or establishment keyword (e.g., 'Amazon', 'Tesla', 'Walmart', 'United Parcel Service', 'Tyson').

stateCode.title: U.S. State Code (Optional)
stateCode.description: Optional 2-letter U.S. state abbreviation (e.g., 'TX', 'CA', 'IL', 'OH', or leave empty for nationwide).

maxResults.title: Maximum Inspections to Audit
maxResults.description: Maximum number of OSHA establishment inspection records to extract and score (1 to 100).

siteCity.title: Site City
siteCity.description: City where the inspected facility is located.

naicsCode.title: NAICS Industry Code
naicsCode.description: 6-digit North American Industry Classification System code.

inspectionType.title: Inspection Type
inspectionType.description: Complaint, Referral, Fatality/Catastrophe, or Planned inspection.

openDate.title: Inspection Open Date
openDate.description: ISO date when the OSHA inspection opened.

totalViolations.title: Total Citations
totalViolations.description: Total number of OSHA standards cited.

seriousWillfulRepeatCount.title: Serious / Willful / Repeat Citations
seriousWillfulRepeatCount.description: Count of high-severity (Serious, Willful, or Repeat) citations.

currentPenaltyUsd.title: Current Penalty (USD)
currentPenaltyUsd.description: Assessed OSHA civil monetary penalty in USD.

workplaceRiskScore.title: Workplace Safety Risk Score (0-100)
workplaceRiskScore.description: Quantitative EHS and supply-chain underwriting risk score (0-100).

markdownSafetyBrief.title: Markdown EHS & Underwriting Audit Brief
markdownSafetyBrief.description: Executive Markdown dossier for ESG auditors, insurance underwriters, and M&A due diligence.

overview.title: US OSHA Workplace Safety & Violation Compliance Overview
